limitations: Progress toward the complete physical goal. Fixed boundary polyhedra separate volume changes; reference quadrature and native quadrature/ports are measured separately with byte-identical frozen model inputs. Radius changes remain declared different physical problems. U raw peaks grow on fixed reentrant polygonal edges. Fine smooth-CAD reference sweeps remain outside this checkpoint while running. Both force-control normal and prior displacement-control regressions pass unchanged residual criteria. The coupled full-U pilot retains its invalid-initial-geometry and initial-support failures; no failed reference is counted as physically validated. Later coupled attempts, complete contact/refinement/profile/count sensitivity, full egg/Franka and warmed cost acceptance remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
